azureResourceGraph.query:
resourcechanges
| where type == "microsoft.resources/changes"
| extend 
    timestamp = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
    change_type = tostring(properties.changeType),
    resourceType = tostring(properties.targetResourceType)
| where timestamp >= ago(24h)
| where change_type == "Create"
| where resourceType startswith "Microsoft.Network/"
| extend resource = tostring(split(resourceType, "/")[1])
| summarize create = count() by resource
| order by create desc

resourcechanges
| where properties.targetResourceType contains 'microsoft.Network'
	and properties.changeAttributes.correlationId != '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
| extend KST = datetime_add('hour',9,todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp))
| extend changeTime=format_datetime(KST,'yy-MM-dd [HH:mm]')
| where todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp) > ago(24h) and (properties.changeType =~ "create" or properties.changeType =~ "delete")
| parse properties.targetResourceId with * '/Microsoft.Network/' ResType '/' ResName
| project changeTime, Res = strcat_array(pack_array(ResName,"(",ResType,')') ,''),changeType = properties.changeType, changedBy=properties.changeAttributes.changedBy,  correlationId=tostring(properties.changeAttributes.correlationId), subscriptionId, resourceGroup,ResName
| join kind=leftouter hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId
| project-away subscriptionId, subscriptionId1
| project-rename subscription=name
| summarize
    ActionTime=arg_max(changeTime,changeTime),
    subscription=make_set(subscription),
    resourceGroup=make_set(resourceGroup),
    Res=make_set(Res),
    ResName=make_set(ResName),
    changeType=make_set(changeType),
    User=make_set(changedBy)
    by correlationId
| project ActionTime , ResName = tostring(ResName.[0]), ResCount = tostring(countof (tostring(Res),"(")), subs = strcat_array(subscription, ","), rg = strcat_array(resourceGroup, ","),User1 = strcat_array(User, ", "), changeType = strcat_array(changeType, ","), All_Resource_Lists = strcat_array(Res, ",\n"), correlationId
| extend User2=replace_string(User1,'2cf9eb86-36b5-49dc-86ae-9a63135dfa8c', 'Azure Traffic Manager and DNS')
| extend User=replace_string(User2,'7319c514-987d-4e9b-ac3d-d38c4f427f4c', 'AzureContainerService')
| project ActionTime,subs, rg, Resource = strcat(ResName,"  (Total : ",ResCount,")"), changeType,  User,All_Resource_Lists, correlationId
| order by ActionTime desc

resourcechanges
| where type == "microsoft.resources/changes"
| extend 
    timestamp = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
    change_type = tostring(properties.changeType),
    resourceType = tostring(properties.targetResourceType)
| where timestamp >= ago(24h)
| where change_type == "Delete"
| where resourceType startswith "Microsoft.Network/"
| extend resource = tostring(split(resourceType, "/")[1])
| summarize create = count() by resource
| order by create desc

resources
| where type =~ "Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses"
| where isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) and isnull(properties.natGateway)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project subsName = name, subscriptionId
) on subscriptionId
| project name, resourceGroup, subscription = subsName
| order by subscription asc

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type has "microsoft.Network/virtualnetworks"
| extend IpPrefix = replace("['\"\\[\\]]", "", tostring(properties.addressSpace.addressPrefixes))
| join kind=leftouter hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project subscription=name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId 
| project id, subscription, resourceGroup, location, VnetName = name,IpPrefix, Snet = array_length(properties.subnets)
| join kind=leftouter hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resources
    | where type has "microsoft.Network/virtualnetworks" 
    | project id, properties
    | mv-expand peers = properties.virtualNetworkPeerings
    | project id, remoteVnet = peers.properties.remoteVirtualNetwork.id
    | parse remoteVnet with * "/virtualNetworks/" remoteVnetName
    | order by id asc) on id
| project subscription, resourceGroup, location, VnetName, IpPrefix, Snet, remoteVnetName, ispeered = isnotempty(remoteVnetName)
| summarize Peering = make_list_if(remoteVnetName, ispeered > 0) by subscription, resourceGroup, location, VnetName, IpPrefix, Snet
| project subscription, resourceGroup,location, ['리소스명'] = VnetName, IpPrefix, Snet, Peering = strcat_array(Peering,', ')

resources
| where type has "microsoft.Network/virtualnetworks" 
| join kind=leftouter hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId 
| project-away subscriptionId, subscriptionId1
| project-rename subscription=name1
| mv-expand SubNet = properties.subnets
| extend snetPrefix = strcat_array(SubNet.properties.addressPrefixes,"")
| project  subscription,resourceGroup,['리전'] = location,Vnet = name, Snet_Name=tostring(SubNet.name), IP_Prefix = coalesce(SubNet.properties.addressPrefix,snetPrefix),NSG = coalesce(tostring(split(SubNet.properties.networkSecurityGroup.id, "/")[8]), "No NSG")

resources
| where type has "microsoft.Network/networksecuritygroups"
| join kind=leftouter hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId   
| project-away subscriptionId, subscriptionId1
| project-rename subscription=name1
| mv-expand rules = properties.securityRules
| project
    subscription, resourceGroup,['리전']= location,name,
    direction = tostring(rules.properties.direction),
    RuleName = tostring(rules.name),
    Priority = toint(rules.properties.priority),
    access = tostring(rules.properties.access),
    Protocol = toupper(tostring(rules.properties.protocol)),
    SourceIp = strcat(strcat_array(rules.properties.sourceAddressPrefixes,', '),strcat_array(rules.properties.sourceAddressPrefix,', ')),
    SourcePort = strcat(strcat_array(rules.properties.sourcePortRanges,', '),strcat_array(rules.properties.sourcePortRange,', ')) ,
    DestinationIp = strcat(strcat_array(properties.destinationAddressPrefix,', '),strcat_array(rules.properties.destinationAddressPrefixes,', ')),
    DestinationPort = strcat(strcat_array(rules.properties.destinationPortRange,', '),strcat_array(rules.properties.destinationPortRanges,', '))
| order by name asc, direction asc, Priority asc

// 외부 부하 분산 장치
resources
| where type contains "Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers"
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId 
| project-away subscriptionId, subscriptionId1
| project-rename subscription=name1
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resources
    | where type contains "Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers"
    | project id, properties
    | mv-expand FrontendIPconf = properties.frontendIPConfigurations
    | project id, FrontendIP = FrontendIPconf.properties.publicIPAddress.id) on id    
| project name, subscription, resourceGroup,location, FrontendIP = tostring(FrontendIP), type
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type contains "Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses"
    | project FrontendIP = id, name, IP = properties.ipAddress) on FrontendIP
| summarize IP = make_set(IP) by name, subscription, resourceGroup, type, location
| project type,subscription, resourceGroup, ['리전'] = location,name, IP = strcat_array(IP, ", ")

// 내부 부하 분산 장치
resources
| where type contains "Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers"
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId 
| project-away subscriptionId, subscriptionId1
| project-rename subscription=name1
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resources
    | where type contains "Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers"
    | project id, properties
    | mv-expand FrontendIPconf = properties.frontendIPConfigurations
    | project id, FrontendIP = FrontendIPconf.properties.privateIPAddress) on id    
| project name, subscription, resourceGroup, FrontendIP = tostring(FrontendIP),location, type
| where isnotempty(FrontendIP)
| summarize IP = make_set(FrontendIP) by name, subscription, location,resourceGroup, type
| project type,subscription,['리전'] = location, resourceGroup,name, IP = strcat_array(IP, ", ")

resources
| where type contains "Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways"
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project name, subscriptionId) on subscriptionId 
| project-away subscriptionId, subscriptionId1
| project-rename subscription=name1
| join kind=inner hint.strategy=shuffle(
    resources
    | where type contains "Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways"
    | project id, properties
    | mv-expand FrontendIPconf = properties.frontendIPConfigurations
    | project id, FrontendIP = FrontendIPconf.properties.publicIPAddress.id) on id    
| project name, subscription, resourceGroup, FrontendIP = tostring(FrontendIP),location,type
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type contains "Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses"
    | project FrontendIP = id, name, IP = properties.ipAddress) on FrontendIP
| summarize IP = make_set(IP) by name, subscription, resourceGroup,location,type
| project subscription, resourceGroup,['리전'] = location,type,name, IP = strcat_array(IP, ", ")
